description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets available in two languages, labeled “1” and “2” in the legend, over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and employs a logarithmic scale, with tick labels at 10⁰, 10¹, and 10². The value range extends from approximately 0 to 100. For each year, there are two bars: a blue bar representing language “1” and an orange bar representing language “2”. In 2012, the blue bar extends to approximately 3 datasets, while the orange bar is at 1. The blue bars generally increase in height from 2012 to 2022, reaching a maximum of approximately 80 datasets in 2022. The orange bars also show an increasing trend, peaking at approximately 30 datasets in 2022, but remain consistently shorter than the blue bars across all years. The bars are arranged sequentially by year, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
